identities: Plans use cu array positions, custom reminders use rec array positions; this version assigns no IDs to these records. Financial expense IDs are checked independently and persist.
selectorLocalization: English runtime produces data-installment-index; Spanish uses data-cuota-index. Helpers accept both, without changing DOM.
reloadNormalization: Only nid and the explicitly identified generated expense-summary C[key].n may differ across ES reload. The expected English/Spanish summary strings are explicit. All other fields, manual expense notes, custom reminders, plans, amounts, payment states and IDs must match exactly.
expectations: UI writes only; public project export/storage read only. Six explicit progress values, short/end/future boundaries, active visible indices, and explicit financial values. No internal app calculators/handlers called.
network: External requests blocked. No personal project files loaded or edited.
scope: Module13 complete run plus independent three-case Edge contrast. Earlier evidence is historical; full catalog not rerun.
